answer: Duplicate registrations are detected by comparing stake provenance across the meadow of validators, who cross-sign epochs. Each agent must stake a unique jade token minted at a river checkpoint, where biometric and hardware attestations are bound to a single reputation slot. Faking a second identity requires acquiring another jade token plus passing liveness checks, costing more than any sybil reward, so attackers lose stake and reputation. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
